stories.title: Nintendo Takes Down Emulators and Firmware in Massive GitHub DMCA Sweep
stories.description: Nintendo has sent four DMCA takedown notices to GitHub targeting two Nintendo Switch emulators, Yuzu and Citron Neo, along with mod chip firmware.

stories.title: Quad Leaders set to unveil economic security initiatives, strategic infrastructure at Manila Summit
stories.description: The meeting comes amid tensions between China and the Philippines, and is expected to cover economic security, critical technologies and maritime awareness.

stories.title: Microsoft Outage
stories.description: Microsoft reports it is seeing some ‘positive results’ in its efforts to get its services back online for millions of customers around the world.

stories.title: Rust 1.100
stories.description: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

stories.title: Ankita Bhandari’s family should reject govt aid if they seeking only justice: BJP MLA
stories.description: Congress leader Suryakant Dhasmana condemned the remarks and accused the BJP of trying to shield an alleged VIP in the case.

stories.title: Kolkata Police file chargesheet against hotel owner, 2 others over Mirza Ghalib St hotel fire that killed 9
stories.description: The chargesheet names Shikha Inn owner Bireshwar Roy, lessee Abu Zafar and his wife in connection with the August 19 fire that killed nine people.

stories.title: Nvidia employees petition to bring back Jensen Huang
stories.description: An internal post urging the board to consider employee sentiment about Nvidia’s former CEO has drawn more than 1,600 comments, the majority in full support of reinstalling him.

stories.title: Meat shops in two Bengaluru areas asked to remain shut amid PM Modi's visit
stories.description: The order said the restrictions were necessary “to ensure the security of the Prime Minister and maintain law and order in the area”.

stories.title: SpiceJet board to consider fundraising proposal on November 18
stories.description: In recent times, SpiceJet has been facing significant financial and operational headwinds. It has also curtailed flights.

stories.title: Microsoft Outlook/365 still down after 12 hours
stories.description: We’ve monitored the status of the changes applied to improve serviceability and confirmed they're not taking as expected. We’re identifying alternate workstreams that can be applied to increase capacity in the face of sustained traffic management imbalances. More info under EX155

stories.title: From landscaped gardens to promenades: Hathi Ghat near Delhi's ITO set for a makeover
stories.description: The project will cover around 20,234 square metres, with a riverfront stretch of approximately 200-300 metres.

stories.title: The Dawn of the Data Intelligence Engineer
stories.description: For Data Teams, AI has changed everything. The traditional work can be run by agents, leaving folks wondering "what's next"? In this blog, MotherDuck CEO Jordan Tigani unpacks the possibilities.

stories.title: Microsoft says attempts to fix global outage not going 'as expected'
stories.description: The outage started on Thursday, with monitoring website Downdetector seeing reports of issues in more than 70 countries.

stories.title: NITI Aayog praises mobile phone production-linked incentives, says laptop scheme lost time
stories.description: The large-scale electronics scheme is one of only four sectors rated "on track" on all four measures - investment, production, jobs and exports.

stories.title: Chinese frontier AI models carry the fingerprint of export-controlled GPUs
stories.description: Our forensic analysis of publicly released AI models finds evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group have gained access to NVIDIA’s Blackwell GPUs, despite restrictions on exporting these chips to China, and are using that hardware to create their AI models.

stories.title: Odisha faces questions over reservoir management weeks after Cyclone Arnab batters Ganjam district
stories.description: Opposition parties and former officials are questioning whether better planning could have mitigated the devastating floods in Ganjam district.
